summary: PMV Pharmaceuticals filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and common stock warrants. Terms include a purchase price per share and accompanying warrant, pre-funded warrant exercise price of $0.00001, and five-year warrants with an initial exercise price to be set. The warrants feature a reset based on FDA NDA acceptance for rezatapopt and a potential mandatory exercise of 50% for cash. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: pricing and warrant terms.
